limits.text: 01Helix is nonclinical: not a diagnostic, variant classification or medical advice tool. ClinVar's classification is shown as a database record with its review status, not as advice.

02The curated sets of this build are CFTR, FAAH2 and HBB; other genes are refused rather than built from uncurated data. This set (CFTR) carries the gene, its MANE Select transcript and sequences, the protein record and its curated variant, one experimental structure (PDB 5UAK) and a predicted model (listed, not loaded).

03The data are a snapshot of public records with a retrieval date and record versions (see Evidence World), not a live feed. Records change between builds. ClinVar's record for F508del is VCV000007105.214 in this build.

045UAK (electron microscopy) is a structure of the reference protein: the 3D view shows the position of Phe 508, the residue F508del deletes; the deletion itself is not modelled in 3D, and the change is compared on the sequence only.

05The contacts shown for Phe 508 are computed in the deposited asymmetric unit, within the residue's own chain (asymmetric unit, model 1, no symmetry mates; the residue's own chain included beyond its covalent neighbours (one mapped chain)). Symmetry-related molecules were not generated, so contacts across them are not assessed.
06One numbering applies to P13569: translated (HGVS, UniProt; Met = 1), which the residue numbers of 5UAK follow. Helix still maps through the SIFTS record, never by assuming the two are equal.

07Codon k maps to protein position k because the CDS translates exactly to UniProt P13569. SIFTS maps positions 1 to 1480 onto 5UAK chain A; positions outside the deposited coordinates and the stop codon have no structure residue.
08The DNA helix is illustrative geometry: the bases, their order and the exons are real, the shape and spacing are not to scale.
09The AlphaFold model of P13569 is listed as a computational prediction but is never used to place the variant and is not loaded.

10A language model, when one is available, only proposes a plan of fixed actions; deterministic code checks every identifier and executes. Its wording is never a scientific claim. Its suggested next questions are shown only when a fixed filter finds them nonclinical and answerable with the curated data. Without a model, a rule-based planner answers a limited set of questions.
11Evidence World v1 is a page layer, not yet a world the planner can enter: the plan vocabulary has no evidence world, and adding one would change the Phase 3 prompt.
12Tested in headless Chrome on one Mac. Safari, Firefox and the desktop webview were not run in this phase.
